CREATE X and REPLACE X are one entry each, as the manuals document them on one page.
SEL/DEL/INS/UPD, BT/ET abbreviations are covered by their full statements, not separate entries.

Skipped non-statements: SELECT clause topics (WITH DELETED ROWS, AS JSON, QUALIFY, SAMPLE, EXPAND ON...), WRITE_NOS (table operator), LDILoadGroup query band, END-EXEC terminator, EXEC SQL prefix, the bare GRANT/REVOKE overview topics, duplicate forms (embedded FETCH/OPEN, COMMENT Returning Form, embedded DATABASE, DECLARE HANDLER per-type pages, SELECT AS OF version_number, EXEC).

Not reached: foreign server (CREATE/ALTER/DROP/SHOW/HELP FOREIGN SERVER) and replication group statements are not in the 20.00 SQL DDL/DML/DCL/SPL manuals or the Lake SQL guide (likely in QueryGrid/legacy docs); not listed.
